readme: Rules text for SphereDex, keyed by base card number. Parallel printings (OSR, SSP, SP, and the rest) inherit the base entry. To add a set, append entries under cards. Leave a card out rather than guessing its text. text is the printed rules text only (flavour with no rules is an empty string). keywords are glossary terms that appear in that text. Source: palworldtcg.gg public card API (https://palworldtcg.gg/api/v1/cards), cached 2026-09-27 for offline use. Glossary lines follow that site's Comprehensive Rules guide. Card text and rules belong to Bushiroad / Pocketpair.

Quick.text: Can be played during the Quick Step, which follows block declaration and comes before damage resolves.

Interrupt.text: A Quick activated ability that nullifies the attack. Pay its listed cost during the Quick Step.

Taunt.text: Your opponent must choose this card as their attack target when they can, keeping attacks off your Master.

Stealth.text: This card cannot be blocked, so its attack reaches the target it chose.

Assault.text: This card can choose a Pal in the stand state as its attack target, opening lines that are normally unavailable.

Breakthrough.text: If the opposing combat Pal is put into the graveyard while this card is attacking, deal this card's Strike to that Pal's Master.

Retaliate.text: When this Pal is put into the graveyard while battling, the opposing combat Pal is put into the graveyard too.

Vigilance.text: Stands this card at the end of your turn, so it can attack and still be ready to block.

Brave.text: On Attack, this card's Power increases by the listed number until end of turn.

Serious.text: On Assign, choose 1 Pal: its Power increases by the listed number until end of turn.

Nocturnal.text: While it is night, this card's Power increases by the listed number.

Legendary.text: Only 1 Legendary Pal with the same card name can be put into your base at a time. Different Legendary Pals can stand side by side, but a second copy of the same one cannot be placed.
